A diagram that shows an algorithm using shapes and arrows is called a ____.
Breaking a problem into smaller parts is called ____.
In a flowchart, the ____ shape contains a question with a Yes/No answer.
A mistake in an algorithm or program is called a ____.
Write an algorithm, as numbered steps, to find the larger of two numbers.
questions.answer: 1 Start. 2 Input number A and number B. 3 If A > B then output A, otherwise output B. 4 Stop. (1 mark for input, 1 mark for comparing, 1 mark for output of the larger.)

questions.q: Explain why it is useful to draw a flowchart before writing a program.
questions.answer: Any two from: it shows the logic clearly; mistakes can be found and fixed early; it is easier to explain the plan to other people; it makes the program easier to write.

questions.q: State two features of a good algorithm.
questions.answer: Any two from: clear, unambiguous steps; steps in the correct order; it finishes (has an end); it solves the problem correctly.
